description: A `cel` tool's expression is parsed when the document is checked, so one that does not parse fails before any effect runs, naming the effect, the same way a `mode: cel` `if` does. The parser's own message is third-party text, compared by location only. electricity has no `cel` tool yet and refuses the document with the preview marker.
location_pattern: CEL expression at 'prime\.effects\[\d+\]' \(effect '\w+'\): expression does not parse
